title: Visual identity in a space
slide_intent: Adapt identity to an existing place because the resident’s experience depends on how graphics work with materials and functions.
strategic_value: Helsinki can make its spaces more useful and recognizable by choosing colors and shapes that add value to the setting.
demonstration: This webpage introduction asks how visual identity can enhance spaces, existing materials and functions while adding value for residents.
practical_value: Assess the place and its users before adding a branded surface.

content_islands.name: Spatial questions
content_islands.spec: Keep the resident-value and existing-environment questions beneath the heading.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source asks whether identity adds resident value and enhances the existing environment.
reference_purposes.Application: It suggests applying identity through colors and shapes in a space.
